verifier_findings: The train.py-only patch implements one attributable architecture change: averaging two same-table gathers for every existing bigram/trigram VE lookup, without adding parameters or changing table geometry, gates, projections, optimizer settings, precision flags, or kernels.

The primary hash remains unchanged. The alternate hash uses the specified disjoint primes and XOR salt on the same causal token-history tensors. Products, including padding ID 8192, fit in nonnegative int32; both hashes use the existing modulus.

The default-on toggle has the neighboring BooleanOptionalAction and environment-override pattern, is saved through ARCH_TOGGLE_NAMES, and restores missing checkpoint keys to False. load_for_eval reaches the same shared forward implementation.
Disabling the toggle avoids alternate hash tensor operations and extra gathers and retains the original single-gather expression and downstream mathematics.

The patch preserves the 30-minute budget accounting, checkpoint reserve, distributed/full-chip execution, and seed-42 default. Data, tokenizer, evaluation procedures, and fresh-training defaults are unchanged; no external-data or pretrained path is introduced. Supplied deterministic checks pass; runtime and scoring gates remain for the controller.
